rubys-tutor.line: The man who gives Ruby her lessons on Oro.
rubys-tutor.short: Ruby's tutor on Oro. He appears without a sound and asks her the lesson: how did everything begin?
rubys-tutor.summary: Ruby's tutor on Oro. He stands in the shadow of a pillar, and Ruby does not hear him come. He never looks at her doll. He asks the lesson, and when she recites that nobody on Oro may grow strong enough to upset the order, he adds: "That includes the heir."

academy-gate-guard.line: The guard who keeps the Academy gate.
academy-gate-guard.short: The guard at the Academy gate. When Guinevere asks for post on rest days, the answer is "Nothing today."
academy-gate-guard.summary: The guard who keeps the gate of Selrick Academy. Every rest day Guinevere asks at the gate for post from home, and every time the guard says "Nothing today." Four days before her final trial, a guard calls her to the gate, where Hester waits outside the bars.

attendance-clerk.line: The clerk at the Academy's attendance desk.
attendance-clerk.short: The clerk at the attendance desk. He frowns when Selena comes in late after a night out.
attendance-clerk.summary: The clerk at the Academy's attendance desk. When Selena comes in late after a storm run, he frowns at his tablet and tells her that her guardian called first thing about a fever. He looks her up and down and says she looks fine. "It broke," says Selena.

baker.line: A baker in Terrinia whose smile Selena copies as a child.
baker.short: A baker in Terrinia. As a small child Selena practices his smile in the dark window glass.
baker.summary: A baker in Terrinia. As a small child Selena practices smiles in the window glass, and his is one of the first she tries. She tells Karina her new smile came from the baker, and Karina says it looks better on her. Later, walking home past the bakery, Selena gives him his own smile, and he waves.

big-man-at-the-crews-yard.line: A big buyer who tries to force Selena's price with his fists.
big-man-at-the-crews-yard.short: A big man at the crews' yard. He shouts at Selena over a crate of plating and tries to force her price.
big-man-at-the-crews-yard.summary: A big man who buys salvage at the crews' yard. One night he shouts at Selena over a crate of plating: "Half price, or I take it!" He swings at her twice and misses, the second time hitting a post, then pins a hand beside her head. He trips on the tarp rope, falls in the mud and stamps off swearing. Vexana waits in the dark for him to leave before she steps into Selena's lamp.

boy-at-the-gate.line: A student at the gate who notices Selena's horns.
boy-at-the-gate.short: A student at the Academy gate. He looks twice at Selena's horns and asks where she got them.
boy-at-the-gate.summary: A student at the Academy gate. The first morning Selena lets her own horns show, behind a horned headband, he is the only one who looks twice. "Nice. Where'd you get those?" She says she grew them. He laughs and goes on.

boy-from-the-drill-line.line: A cadet in Guinevere's drill line.
boy-from-the-drill-line.short: A cadet in Guinevere's drill line. When he skins his palm, she has a band-aid on it before he can say no.
boy-from-the-drill-line.summary: A cadet in Guinevere's drill line. When he skins his palm, she has a band-aid on it before he can say no, and tells him Baroque money paid for that too. He laughs with her. On Team-Up Day he sees her coming to ask him, goes pink and grabs the boy beside him as his partner.

boy-in-the-second-row.line: A student in Chang'e's class who keeps asking questions.
boy-in-the-second-row.short: A boy in the second row of Chang'e's class. He asks what her words mean.
boy-in-the-second-row.summary: A boy in the second row of Chang'e's class. During her lesson on the Will of the Planet he keeps asking what the words mean: "Balance?" Then what the Control Core is. Then what a black hole is.

boy-on-the-stairs.line: A student who calls Selena dangerous on the Academy stairs.
boy-on-the-stairs.short: A student on the Academy stairs. He calls Selena dangerous, meaning it as praise.
boy-on-the-stairs.summary: A student at the Academy. Leaning over the stair rail, he calls out that the things in Selena's head are dangerous, and he means it as praise. Selena promises him he will come to know the real her one day, and the whole stairwell laughs. Much later, when Selena shows her real self, nobody laughs.

boy-under-the-shutter.line: A small boy pinned under an iron shutter after a raid.
boy-under-the-shutter.short: A small boy pinned under a shop's iron shutter after a raid, crying in the rain.
boy-under-the-shutter.summary: A small boy caught after a raid, with a fallen shop's iron shutter across his leg, crying in the rain. Selena lifts the shutter, which two grown men could not have shifted, and whispers: "Shh. It won't hurt anymore." She turns him toward the rescue lamps and tells him to shout. He limps off shouting, and the lamps turn toward him.

boy-with-a-hook.line: A young scavenger in the base's ruins.
boy-with-a-hook.short: A young scavenger in the ruins of the base. He tells Selena that hooks are extra.
boy-with-a-hook.summary: A young scavenger who picks through the ruins of the research base after its fall. He looks Selena over when she joins them: "You're new. Hooks are extra." She uses her hands instead.

boy-with-the-red-tie.line: A Selrick student guarding a hiding child with empty hands.
boy-with-the-red-tie.short: A boy in a Selrick uniform with a red tie. He stands in front of a barrel, hands empty and shaking, and does not move.
boy-with-the-red-tie.summary: A boy in a Selrick uniform with a red tie. During the attack on Terrinia he stands in front of a barrel, hands empty and shaking, where a small child hides. He begs Ruby: "Please, it's only a kid." She knocks him aside with the flat of her scythe, and the barrel rolls away. He shouts at her from the ground, and she does not hear him.

boy-with-the-skinned-knee.line: A boy in Selena's childhood class.
boy-with-the-skinned-knee.short: A boy in Selena's class who skins his knee on the school steps and picks at the scab for a week.
boy-with-the-skinned-knee.summary: A boy in Selena's class when she was small. He skins his knee on the school steps, howls, and picks at the scab for a week. Selena watches it until it is gone. Her own scrapes are always gone before she thinks to look, and she later compares a cut that healed purple with his week-long knee.

camera-droid.line: The droid that takes the Best Aspirant Duo photographs.
camera-droid.short: A camera droid at the foot of the stage. It asks Guinevere and Vexana to stand closer.
camera-droid.summary: A droid that takes photographs at the Best Aspirant Duo ceremony. It asks Guinevere and Vexana to stand closer, asks for more shots because someone blinked, and asks for one back to back for the courtyard. It prints the hand-in-hand picture, one copy each, in a thin black frame, and sends the photo to both their phones.

combat-division-boy.line: A Combat Division student who calls Selena a hero.
combat-division-boy.short: A boy from the Combat Division. At the year's showing he tells Selena she will be a hero with Silverbolt.
combat-division-boy.summary: A boy from the Combat Division. At the year's showing he leans over the rope around Silverbolt and tells Selena she will be a hero with that thing. Selena says being a champion of justice sounds like a pain in the shoulders, and she will pass. He laughs.

counseling-woman.line: An older woman in the Academy's counseling section.
counseling-woman.short: An older woman in the counseling section. She pours tea and asks Guinevere to tell her about Vexana.
counseling-woman.summary: An older woman who works in the Academy's counseling section. In a room with soft chairs and a window full of plants, she pours two cups of tea and asks Guinevere to sit down and tell her about Vexana. Guinevere sits, says "She's alive," and leaves at once. The tea stays full on the table.

courier.line: A messenger who brings Ruby the Council's order.
courier.short: A courier who brings Ruby the Council's order: build a sharper blade for the Balance Keepers.
courier.summary: A courier on Oro, who brings Ruby the Council's order to build a blade sharper than any the Balance Keepers have. That order is how Angela comes to be made.

examiner.line: The examiner at Selena's Science Division entry.
examiner.short: The examiner at the Science Division entry, who takes Selena's paper without a word about her empty name box.
examiner.summary: The examiner at the Science Division's entry test. Selena leaves the family-name box on her form empty, and it glows red. She waits for questions or a shut door. The examiner takes her paper without a word and calls the next name.

girl-at-the-cake-counter.line: The girl behind the counter of the girls' house cake shop.
girl-at-the-cake-counter.short: The girl behind the counter at the cake shop. She tells Guinevere one of everything on the top row is eleven cakes.
girl-at-the-cake-counter.summary: The girl who works behind the counter of the girls' house, a cake shop down the hill from the Academy. When Guinevere orders one of everything on the top row, she points out that it is eleven cakes. Guinevere orders eleven.

girl-at-the-next-desk.line: Selena's classmate at the next desk.
girl-at-the-next-desk.short: A girl at the desk next to Selena's. She asks whether Selena's drawing is a suit design.
girl-at-the-next-desk.summary: A classmate at the desk next to Selena's. As Selena draws a suit of armor on her desk screen over months, the girl asks whether it is a suit design. Selena says something like that. She is drawing the shape she feels folded under her own skin.

girl-with-two-braids.line: A girl at the Shield's home who offers Vexana a ribbon.
girl-with-two-braids.short: A girl with two braids at the Shield's home. She offers Vexana a blue ribbon so they would match.
girl-with-two-braids.summary: A girl with two braids at the Shield's home for soldiers' children. At breakfast she sits by Vexana and offers her a blue ribbon so they would match. Vexana says no, and the girl takes her bowl to another table. Years later, when Guinevere says "Now we match," Vexana remembers her.

girls-mother.line: The mother of the girl in the red dress.
girls-mother.short: The mother of the girl in the red dress. Fanny leaves the girl's pink rabbit where a mother coming back would see it.
girls-mother.summary: The mother of the girl in the red dress, caught in the attack at the breach. After the fighting, Fanny sets the girl's pink rabbit on a broken wall, facing the avenue, where a mother coming back would see it. Fanny later says the mother was running to the girl when Fanny left her behind a van.
rows: The girl in the red dress

gray-haired-professor.line: A gray-haired professor of the Science Division.
gray-haired-professor.short: A Science Division professor. He sets a dead pump on Selena's bench and stands back to watch.
gray-haired-professor.summary: A gray-haired professor in the Science Division. On Selena's first days he sets a dead pump on her bench and stands back to watch. Later, leaning in the doorway of Chang'e's lab, he calls Silverbolt's refusal to move for anyone else fine tuning: tuned to one pilot, like the director's own gear.

grumbling-classmate.line: A Science Division classmate who grumbles about Selena.
grumbling-classmate.short: A classmate who grumbles that Selena always walks away without a scratch.
grumbling-classmate.summary: A classmate of Selena's in the Science Division. Picking glass out of his sleeve after a test rig blew, he grumbles that she always walks away without a scratch. He does not know how true that is.

gunner.line: A gunner at Lesley's Shield station.
gunner.short: A gunner in the east gun pit. He fires into an Ender's open core and kills it.
gunner.summary: A gunner at the Shield station where Lesley grew up. In the first raid she sees, an Ender's chest opens over the east gun pit and the light of its core fills his face. He fires into the opening and kills it. That night he chalks a stroke on the armory door, where the station keeps its count. Watching him, Lesley learns that the chest opens only when it strikes.

house-servant.line: A servant of House Baroque who brings Guinevere tea.
house-servant.short: A servant of House Baroque who brings Guinevere tea and says the master knows she is there.
house-servant.summary: A servant of House Baroque. While Guinevere waits all day on the bench outside her father's office, the servant brings her tea and says the master knows she is there. The tea goes cold, and the servant brings a fresh pot. Asked whether her father has eaten, the servant says the master took his lunch at his desk.

library-droid.line: The one-lensed droid at the library's front desk.
library-droid.short: The droid at the library's front desk. It turns its one lens to Vexana when she comes in.
library-droid.summary: The droid that sits at the front desk of the Academy library. When Vexana asks for anything on the void, it lists three papers on its screen. The third is Chang'e's, on aspirant power and the black hole, and the droid prints it for her.

man-at-the-fence.line: An onlooker at the Academy's opening day.
man-at-the-fence.short: A man at the fence on opening day. He says the flyers are the instructors: Shield soldiers in the new suits.
man-at-the-fence.summary: A man in the crowd at the fence on the morning Selrick Academy opens its gate. As figures in suits rise on wings of light and fly over the city, he tells everyone they are the instructors, Shield soldiers in the new suits. No suit had flown over the city before that day.

man-under-the-sign.line: A simulated civilian in Fanny's VR assessment.
man-under-the-sign.short: A simulated man trapped under a sign in Fanny's VR test. Civilians are not scored, but Fanny pulls him clear first.
man-under-the-sign.summary: A simulated civilian in Fanny's VR assessment. He shouts from under a fallen sign, and a voice says simulated civilians are not scored. Fanny pulls him clear first anyway, which costs her eleven seconds. Layla reruns the test five times leaving him there, and Fanny's record still reads CIVILIAN RECOVERED, +0:11.

manners-tutor.line: The tutor who taught Guinevere how to bow.
manners-tutor.short: Guinevere's manners tutor, who spent years teaching her how to bow.
manners-tutor.summary: One of Guinevere's tutors at House Baroque. She talked all day about a lady's refinement, which meant how you hold your back, and spent years teaching Guinevere how to bow. Guinevere knows that bow at once when Ruby plants her scythe and bows at the lot.

medic.line: A medic who patches up the fighters after a battle.
medic.short: A medic who tapes Layla's cheek and wraps her forearm after the battle.
medic.summary: A medic who tends the fighters after the fighting. After the battle at the breach, a medic tapes Layla's cheek and wraps her left forearm in gauze. After the fish-market raid a medic tapes Guinevere's wrist, tells her to rest, and allows her bag work with her left hand only.

night-shift-researcher.line: A researcher at the base whose birthday cake Chang'e shares.
night-shift-researcher.short: A night-shift researcher at the base. The lab finds flour and sugar for his birthday cake and sings to him, badly.
night-shift-researcher.summary: A researcher on the night shift at the research base. For his birthday someone finds flour and sugar, and the whole lab sings to him over the benches, badly. Chang'e carries a slice out to Lesley, because it is his birthday, so she gets cake.

officer-who-posted-lesley.line: The Shield officer who posts Lesley to the research base.
officer-who-posted-lesley.short: A Shield officer. He sends Lesley, the best young shot they have, to guard the research base's scientists and their child.
officer-who-posted-lesley.summary: A Shield officer with Lesley's file on his desk. He sends her, as the best young shot they have, to keep the research base's two chief scientists and their child alive. After she brings in an Ender core piece whole, he comes out in person, because he will not give these orders over the comm. He sends her on a top secret mission with no radio and no letters, since the Shield thinks the Enders can hear its signals, and says another soldier will take her gate.

old-shield-sergeant.line: The old Shield sergeant who taught Hester to fight.
old-shield-sergeant.short: An old Shield sergeant who taught Hester to fight before House Baroque hired her.
old-shield-sergeant.summary: An old sergeant of the Shield of Dawnbreak, who taught Hester to fight before House Baroque hired her. Hester later passes his lessons on to Guinevere at the sandbag: elbow in, hip first, hands home.

oldest-of-the-scientists.short: The oldest of the city's scientists. He stops at the line in Chang'e's report where she crossed out belief.
oldest-of-the-scientists.summary: The oldest of Terrinia's scientists. Reading Chang'e's report on the first suits, he stops at the line where she crossed out belief and wrote aspirant power. She tells him belief sits still and this reaches, and he copies the word into his own report. When Chang'e lays out her plan to teach young fighters in pairs, he frowns that it is a school, not a regiment.

quartermaster.line: The Shield quartermaster who gives Lesley her tower room.
quartermaster.short: The Shield's quartermaster, who warns Lesley that the tower room is cold and nobody wants it.
quartermaster.summary: The quartermaster of the Shield of Dawnbreak. When Lesley asks for a room at the top of an old tower across the water, the quartermaster warns her it is cold up there and nobody wants it. She says it has a window.

records-clerk.line: A clerk who comes to change Vexana's file.
records-clerk.short: A clerk from the records office. He brings a form to change Vexana's file from Missing to Killed in action.
records-clerk.summary: A clerk from the Academy's records office. Weeks after Vexana is taken, he stands under the board outside the Combat office with a form. There has been no trace since the corridor, he says, and after this long the form says Killed in action. Lesley refuses: no body, no finding. He takes his form back and goes.

schoolteacher.line: Selena's teacher at her childhood school.
schoolteacher.short: Selena's teacher when she was small. She tells Selena to get under the table in a storm, because everyone else is.
schoolteacher.summary: Selena's teacher at school when she was a child. When a storm comes, she tells Selena to get under the table, because everyone else is. Another day, when Selena says the way to stop a street fire is to knock down the next house first, the class gasps and the teacher smiles: that is what the fire crews do. "Clever girl."

scorched-suits-pilot.line: The pilot whose belief once lit a scorched Academy suit.
scorched-suits-pilot.short: The pilot of the scorched Academy suit that Obsidia holds on her ship. A pilot's belief once lit its core.
scorched-suits-pilot.summary: The pilot of an Aspirant suit that ends up scorched black, one arm gone, on the prow of Obsidia's ship. A pilot's belief once lit its core. Vexana had watched two feeders drag the suit from a ditch in the dead ground, its last hand still a fist. When Obsidia asks if she knew the pilot, Vexana says no. Obsidia answers that her hand did, because it had closed.

sergeant-at-the-fence.line: A Shield sergeant who stops Guinevere at the outer fence.
sergeant-at-the-fence.short: A Shield sergeant at the outer ward's fence. He pulls Guinevere down as she climbs it at night.
sergeant-at-the-fence.summary: A Shield sergeant, gray at the temples, with a rifle on his back. One night he pulls Guinevere down by the collar as she climbs the outer ward's fence, and works out who she is from her pink hair and red bows. "No pass, no entry, miss." When she says she will find Vexana, he tells her to do it with a pass, walks her back under the lamp and writes her name in his book. His report reaches her father.
rows: Gray at the temples, a rifle on his back

sergeant-at-the-lot.line: A Shield sergeant at the lot where the black ship lands.
sergeant-at-the-lot.short: A Shield sergeant at the lot, who asks Fanny on whose word she vouches for the newcomers.
sergeant-at-the-lot.summary: A Shield sergeant in the line of soldiers at the cleared lot by the dome's foot. When a black ship lands and Fanny vouches for the two girls who walk down its ramp, the sergeant asks: "On whose word?" Fanny answers: "Mine." She remembers that moment much later, on the platforms.

sergeant-at-the-rail-yard.line: The sergeant of the squad Lesley saves at the rail yard.
sergeant-at-the-rail-yard.short: The sergeant of a Shield squad at the old rail yard. He stares at the whole core piece Lesley brings down.
sergeant-at-the-rail-yard.summary: The sergeant of a Shield squad pinned behind a wagon at the old rail yard. Lesley draws the Ender off them and shoots its core at the edge, so one piece splits away whole. He stares at it and says Ender cores always burn. Nobody had thought it could be done.

shelter-clerk.line: The clerk who writes a card for a nameless girl.
shelter-clerk.short: A clerk at a shelter after a strike. He writes on a card: girl, no name, and guesses her age.
shelter-clerk.summary: A clerk at a table by a shelter door, with a box of cards and ink to the wrist. He writes on a card for a silent child: girl, no name, and guesses her age. He says half the children there have not said a word, from shock. He tells Karina she cannot keep signing the log, and tries names on the girl, Anna and Rose. After a week he stops asking, and Karina keeps her. The girl is Selena.

shield-clerk.line: The clerk who enlists Lesley in the Shield.
shield-clerk.short: The Shield clerk who asks Lesley her date of birth when she joins as a soldier.
shield-clerk.summary: A clerk of the Shield of Dawnbreak. When the Shield takes Lesley as a soldier, the clerk asks her date of birth. She gives it and does not think of it again. It is the one time she gave anyone her birthday.

shield-soldier-on-the-hill.line: The Shield soldier who bandages Lesley's eye.
shield-soldier-on-the-hill.short: A Shield soldier. He winds a dressing over Lesley's left eye, tags her wrist and sends her down the hill.
shield-soldier-on-the-hill.summary: A soldier of the Shield of Dawnbreak, who comes up the hill after the rain thins. He kneels and winds a field dressing around Lesley's head, over the left eye, ties a paper tag to her wrist and tells her to wait at the bottom of the hill. When she asks where the Enders come from, he points down the road out of the city: out there, in groups.

small-girl-at-the-shelter.line: A small girl carried into the seawall shelter.
small-girl-at-the-shelter.short: A small girl on her father's hip, eyes shut, running for the seawall shelter as the Enders come.
small-girl-at-the-shelter.summary: A small girl carried down the avenue on her father's hip, her mother holding her hand, her eyes shut. They reach the seawall shelter's doors with ten steps to spare, and Chang'e takes her place in front of those doors. At dawn the girl rides out of the shelter on her father's hip with her eyes open.

soldier-under-the-slab.line: A wounded soldier pinned under fallen wall.
soldier-under-the-slab.short: A soldier pinned by a slab of fallen wall. Angela lifts it off his legs with her bare hands.
soldier-under-the-slab.summary: A wounded soldier in the bay road cut. A slab of fallen wall pins his legs until Angela lifts it off with her bare hands, and he drags himself clear. When an Ender drops at him from a roof, Angela throws herself over him and takes the claw on her back.

soldier-who-carried-vexana.line: The soldier who carried the young Vexana away.
soldier-who-carried-vexana.short: A soldier who catches the young Vexana from behind, throws her over his shoulder and runs.
soldier-who-carried-vexana.summary: A Shield soldier in the attack on the wall. When an Ender comes at the young Vexana and her father steps between them, this soldier catches her from behind, throws her over his shoulder and runs. She shouts for her father, and he only runs faster. Over his shoulder she watches her father's back as he stays to fight.

soldier-with-the-sling.line: A wounded soldier who walks a small boy to safety.
soldier-with-the-sling.short: A soldier with his arm in a sling. He takes the small boy's hand and walks him back up the street.
soldier-with-the-sling.summary: A wounded soldier in the bay road cut, his arm in a sling. During a lull in the fighting he takes the small boy's hand and walks him back up the street, away from the wall.

stallholder.line: The keeper of the fabric stall in the arcade.
stallholder.short: The keeper of the arcade's fabric stall, who says everybody likes the pink felt.
stallholder.summary: The keeper of the fabric stall in the middle of the arcade, which sells felt in squares of every color. The stallholder says everybody likes the pink, and wraps Vexana's felt in brown paper. Vexana later sews a small pink head and a black one from it.

station-medic.line: The medic at the Shield station who gives Lesley her patch.
station-medic.short: The medic at the Shield station, who swaps Lesley's field dressing for a black patch.
station-medic.summary: The medic at the far Shield station where Lesley is taken as a child, who swaps her field dressing for a black patch over her left eye. Nobody sees under that patch again until Chang'e asks her to take it off.

third-year-teacher.line: The class teacher of Layla, Fanny and Selena.
third-year-teacher.short: Layla and Fanny's class teacher, who waits at the door with folded arms when they arrive late.
third-year-teacher.summary: The teacher of the third-year class, which holds Layla, Fanny and Selena. The teacher waits at the door with folded arms when Layla and Fanny run in late, and tells Selena she is late again, then finds her late note on a tablet, sighs and lets her sleep through the lesson. In the last weeks the teacher goes down a table of this year's suits on the screen and asks Selena to read out the top row.

truck-driver.line: The Shield driver who brings Lesley back toward Terrinia.
truck-driver.short: A Shield truck driver taking Lesley back toward Terrinia. He expects to be home by one.
truck-driver.summary: A Shield driver who carries Lesley back toward Terrinia at the end of her secret mission. He calls back through the cab window that they will be home by one. Past midnight, on the last hill, he brakes hard: the city's edge is burning.

warden.line: The warden of the seawall shelter's iron doors.
warden.short: The warden of the seawall shelter, hauling at one of its iron doors, ready to shut it as the Enders come.
warden.summary: The warden who keeps the iron doors of the seawall shelter. As the Enders come down the avenue, the warden hauls at one door, ready to shut it, and shouts at Chang'e to get in. She stays outside and takes her place in front of the doors instead, and they bang shut behind her.

waterfront-merchant.line: A waterfront merchant who pays Selena for a warning.
waterfront-merchant.short: A merchant on the waterfront who pays Selena for one word: when.
waterfront-merchant.summary: A merchant whose warehouse stands on the waterfront. Selena can feel the Enders' hum gather in her bones a day before a raid, and he pays her for one word. She tells him: tomorrow. He moves his stock out that afternoon, and the next night the warehouse roof comes in.

woman-downstairs.line: Karina's downstairs neighbor, who minds Selena in raids.
woman-downstairs.short: The woman downstairs from Karina's flat. When the sirens come close, Selena is to go down with her.
woman-downstairs.summary: Karina's neighbor in the flat downstairs. When the sirens come close, Selena is to go down with her, and Selena copies the smile she wears for the landlord. She calls Selena a talent for mending radios. One rainy night in a raid she leads Selena by the hand toward the shelter, and when the line breaks, her hand lets go.

workshop-man.line: A workshop man who cheats Selena once.
workshop-man.short: A man from the outskirts' workshops who pays Selena for four plates and walks off with five.
workshop-man.summary: A buyer from the workshops on the outskirts. He pays Selena for four salvage plates and walks off with five. The next week he wants four more, and she counts them out and holds out her hand for the price of five. "Miscounted," she says. He pays, and every workshop on his street hears about the fifth plate.

vexanas-mother.line: Vexana's mother, who died when Vexana was very small.
vexanas-mother.short: Vexana's mother. She died of an illness before Vexana could remember her.
vexanas-mother.summary: Vexana's mother. She died of an illness before Vexana could remember her, so it was always Vexana and her father, in a row of Shield houses in the city wall's shadow.

black-enders.line: Black Enders with long thin limbs.
black-enders.short: Black Enders with long thin limbs. They come down out of the orange sky onto the dome and in through its broken panels.
black-enders.summary: A kind of Ender, black, with long thin limbs. In the Northeastern sector they come down out of the orange sky onto the dome and in through the broken panels. Fanny goes up to fight them in the air while Layla shoots whatever turns toward her back, and Fanny's long blade sweeps through the last of them high in the sky.

long-legged-enders.line: Tall Enders on jointed legs like standing spiders.
long-legged-enders.short: Tall Enders on long jointed legs, like spiders standing up. Four of them step out of the smoke on the bay road.
long-legged-enders.summary: Four Enders taller than the morning's, on long jointed legs like spiders standing up. They step out of the smoke on the bay road and walk close behind Selena without reaching for her. Then they charge Guinevere together, and their legs tangle in the narrow mouth of the cut. All four end up dead before the gap, one across another, so everything behind must climb them.

tall-gray-ender.line: A gray Ender taller than a tower.
tall-gray-ender.short: A gray Ender taller than a tower, walking behind a swarm outside the dome.
tall-gray-ender.summary: A single gray Ender taller than a tower. It walks behind a swarm of black things with too many limbs, out in the open outside the dome, while Layla and Fanny fight back to back. As the sun sinks, the swarm draws back and the tall one goes with it.

ultra-enders.line: Enders named Ultra by the siren.
ultra-enders.short: Enders the siren calls Ultra, attacking the dome in the Northeastern sector. Roger asks if Ultra means Ultimate. Nobody answers.
ultra-enders.summary: The name the siren gives the Enders attacking the defense sphere in Terrinia's Northeastern sector. Roger asks whether Ultra means Ultimate, and nobody answers. Layla knows only three ranks: Plain, Super and Ultimate, the deadliest. The siren said Ultra, and nobody ever answered Roger.

cadets.line: The trainees of Selrick Academy's preparatory year.
cadets.short: The Academy's trainees. In a real siren the instructors herd them into a concrete shelter.
cadets.summary: The trainees of Selrick Academy, before they become Aspirants. In a real siren the instructors herd them into a concrete shelter. On Team-Up Day they ask each other to be partners, and a cadet with no partner can sign the reserve. The Academy pays every cadet a small stipend.

changes-first-parents.line: The unknown parents Chang'e was born to.
changes-first-parents.short: The parents Chang'e was born to. She remembers nothing from before the base and has never asked who they were.
changes-first-parents.summary: The parents Chang'e was born to. She was brought to the research base before she could walk properly and remembers nothing from before. She never asked who her first parents were and never went looking. Years later, clearing Selena's empty family-name box, she thinks of them and still has not asked.

changes-parents.line: The two chief scientists who raised Chang'e.
changes-parents.short: Chang'e's parents. A mended servo from their lab turns up on Selena's table.
changes-parents.summary: The two chief scientists of Terrinia's research base, who took Chang'e in and raised her as their daughter. They stood between her and the giant's light the night the base fell. Years later, Selena finds a servo in the ruins and mends it. Chang'e reads the label tape and says it came from her parents' lab.
rows: Chief scientists of the research base

counseling-section.short: The Academy's counseling office. It sends for Guinevere two mornings after she is caught at the fence.
counseling-section.summary: The counseling section of Selrick Academy. Its room has soft chairs and a window full of plants. It sends for Guinevere two mornings after she is caught climbing the outer fence, and an older woman pours her tea and asks about Vexana. Guinevere does not stay.

demolition-crews.line: City crews pulling down walls in the Northeastern sector.
demolition-crews.short: City crews dropping a wall in the Northeastern sector every nine minutes. Each thump moves a tray in Chang'e's lab.
demolition-crews.summary: Crews clearing the ruins in Terrinia's Northeastern sector after the attack. They drop a wall every nine minutes, and each thump walks a tray of tools closer to the edge of a shelf in Chang'e's lab. At dark they stop, and the building goes still.

guineveres-tutors.line: The tutors who teach Guinevere at House Baroque.
guineveres-tutors.short: Tutors at House Baroque who teach Guinevere accounts, contracts and manners.
guineveres-tutors.summary: The tutors who come to House Baroque to teach Guinevere accounts, contracts and manners. The manners tutor talks all day about a lady's refinement, meaning how you hold your back. Guinevere glues those words to Hester's count, and at the Academy she still mails home every sum they set.

lesleys-squad.line: The squad that follows Lesley into the corridor.
lesleys-squad.short: A squad that comes down the corridor behind Lesley after Vexana is taken.
lesleys-squad.summary: A squad of soldiers that follows Lesley at a run down the Academy corridor, after Vexana is taken. They come in behind her to broken Enders, glass, two black scuffs on the floor, and Guinevere hitting the wall.

lesleys-squads.short: Lesley's squads. On the day the black ships landed they held the giants' front beside Guinevere and Vexana.
lesleys-squads.summary: The squads under Lesley's command. On the day the black ships landed, they held the giants' front beside Guinevere and Vexana until dark.

oros-officers.line: The officers who carry out the Council's orders on Oro.
oros-officers.short: Oro's officers. One reads the Dawnbreak orders in the hangar: save the Rioters and restore balance.
oros-officers.summary: The officers who carry out the Council's orders on Oro. Ruby expects them to see a fault in Angela they cannot locate. In the hangar one reads the orders off a slate: "Planet Dawnbreak. Save the Rioters and restore balance," and tells Angela the Rioters are the people in need of saving. Later an officer reads the charge of treason against Oro to Ruby and Angela and shuts them in a cell with no window and no vent.

patrons-of-selrick-academy.line: The families who give Selrick Academy money.
patrons-of-selrick-academy.short: The families who fund the Academy, thanked on a brass plaque by the fountain. House Baroque comes first.
patrons-of-selrick-academy.summary: The families who give Selrick Academy money. A brass plaque above the courtyard fountain thanks them, with House Baroque first. The Academy sends them reports, and they have the front row at the final trial and at the Best Aspirant Duo ceremony. Both times the chair marked HOUSE BAROQUE stays empty.
rows: House Baroque, first on the plaque

professors.line: The teachers of the Science Division.
professors.short: The Science Division's professors. They marvel at Selena's feel for mechas.
professors.summary: The professors who teach in the Science Division of Selrick Academy. They marvel at Selena's instinctive understanding of the Aspirant mechas. They never realize that she herself is a living source of the technology they study.

records-office.line: The office that keeps the Academy's records.
records-office.short: The Academy's records office. A clerk from it brings a form to change Vexana's file.
records-office.summary: The office that keeps Selrick Academy's records. Weeks after Vexana is taken, it sends a clerk with a form that would change her file from Missing to Killed in action. Lesley refuses, and the file stays Missing.

scavengers.line: Ruin pickers who sift the burned base for salvage.
scavengers.short: Scavengers who pick through the ruins of the fallen base with sacks and hooks. Half of them are children.
scavengers.summary: Scavengers who come to the research base's ruins days after its fall, with Selena among them. They pick through the burned buildings with sacks and hooks, and half of them are children. When the Shield puts guards on the ruins a week later, they move on.

shield-headquarters.line: The command of the Shield of Dawnbreak.
shield-headquarters.short: The Shield's headquarters. It calls Lesley's whole core piece a miracle.
shield-headquarters.summary: The headquarters of the Shield of Dawnbreak. When Lesley brings in a piece of an Ender core whole, it calls that a miracle, and the Shield sends her away on a top secret mission.

beau-monde.line: One of the three powers that rule Oro.
beau-monde.short: One of Oro's three powers, which rule through the Council. It voted to cleanse Dawnbreak.
beau-monde.summary: One of the three powers of Oro, with the Decisionmakers and the Institute of Technology. Together they rule through the Council. All three voted that Dawnbreak would be cleansed and brought into Balance, which meant nobody there would be left outside it, and then Oro would take the planet over.

board-of-house-baroque.line: The elders and partners who run House Baroque.
board-of-house-baroque.short: The board of House Baroque: the House's elders and partners. Guinevere's father holds the head seat.
board-of-house-baroque.summary: The board that runs House Baroque, made up of the House's elders and partners, with Guinevere's father in the head seat. It meets in a long room and talks in numbers: loans for the dome, loans for wards rebuilt after raids. Guinevere gets a chair at the back. When her father names her heir, nobody looks back. It was arranged.

cadets-at-the-fountain.line: Two cadets who whisper about Guinevere at the fountain.
cadets-at-the-fountain.short: Two cadets filling their flasks at the fountain. They say Guinevere's father paid her way.
cadets-at-the-fountain.summary: Two cadets who fill their flasks at the courtyard fountain, under the patrons' plaque. They say Guinevere did not need the glove test because her father paid for it, and go red when she turns her widest smile on them. On Team-Up Day they whisper that her score was bought. When Vexana says "You are strong, Guinevere," they stop, cap their flasks and leave.

children-of-the-shields-home.line: The orphans at the Shield's home for soldiers' children.
children-of-the-shields-home.short: The children at the Shield's home. Most of them lost someone to the Enders.
children-of-the-shields-home.summary: The children who live at the Shield's home for soldiers' children, behind the barracks. Most of them lost someone to the Enders. They sleep while Vexana trains alone in the yard at dawn, and they mend their own clothes.

councils-checkers.short: The Council's checkers. They read what runs in an android's mind. They never read what sleeps.
councils-checkers.summary: The inspectors who check android work for Oro's Council. They read what runs in an android's mind, but never what sleeps. That gap is where Ruby hides a sleeping trojan in Angela.

councils-engineers.line: The engineers who work for Oro's Council.
councils-engineers.short: The Council's engineers on Oro. They taught Ruby to program.
councils-engineers.summary: The engineers of Oro's Council. They taught Ruby to program. When Angela turns on Oro's androids, they cannot find the technical bug in her, so the Council sends for her creator.

gate-guards.line: Two Shield soldiers Lesley posts on the base's gate.
gate-guards.short: Two Shield soldiers Lesley trusts, posted on the base's gate a week after its fall. If asked, they say the Shield sent them.
gate-guards.summary: Two soldiers Lesley trusts, whom she gets the Shield to post on the research base's gate a week after its fall. If Chang'e asks who sent them, they are to say the Shield. Years later, when the Enders return, they fire up the avenue and shout after Chang'e as she runs past them.

gray-armored-soldiers.line: Shield soldiers in gray armor at the cleared lot.
gray-armored-soldiers.short: Soldiers in gray armor forming a line at the cleared lot as an unknown ship comes down.
gray-armored-soldiers.summary: Soldiers in gray armor who form a line at the cleared lot by the dome's foot as an unknown ship lands. When two girls walk down its ramp, they close in with rifles up. They hesitate when the small one speaks, and open a way when Lesley comes across the lot.
rows: The cleared lot by the dome's foot

weapons.name: Rifles
weapons.note: Raised at the two newcomers off the black ship.

institute-of-technology.line: One of the three powers that rule Oro.
institute-of-technology.short: One of Oro's three powers, which rule through the Council. It voted to cleanse Dawnbreak.
institute-of-technology.summary: One of the three powers of Oro, with the Decisionmakers and the Beau Monde. Together they rule through the Council. All three voted that Dawnbreak would be cleansed and brought into Balance, and then annexed by Oro.

posts.line: The Academy's defense stations on Lesley's channel.
posts.short: The defense stations on Lesley's command channel. Under the storm, every one reports clear.
posts.summary: The Academy's defense stations, which answer Lesley on the command channel. When the violet storm comes, she orders all posts to report, because the records say that storm kills every machine under it. The gate reports clear. The infirmary reports clear. Every voice comes back clean.

shield-squads.line: The fighting squads of the Shield of Dawnbreak.
shield-squads.short: Squads of the Shield. At the rail yard, one goes to ground behind a wagon while an Ender reaches for it.
shield-squads.summary: The squads of the Shield of Dawnbreak. At the old rail yard Lesley draws an Ender off one pinned behind a wagon. On the night the base fell, Third squad is cut off and nobody answers the calls for a commander, until Lesley orders all squads to her to hold the avenues. Second and Fourth answer, and they hold, barely, but every squad that might have stopped the giant is out at the edge. Afterward the squads ask for Lesley as their commander.
rows: Lesley, from the night the base fell

shields-combat-division.line: The Shield's fighting arm, which Lesley comes to command.
shields-combat-division.short: The fighting arm of the Shield. Lesley becomes one of its commanders months after the base fell.
shields-combat-division.summary: The combat division of the Shield of Dawnbreak. Months after the base fell, Lesley is given an armband that makes her one of its commanders. Before her first raid in command, a boy at the end of the line asks what they do if the Enders run. She answers that not a single enemy will escape.

students-in-costume.line: Students wearing cat ears and horns at the Academy.
students-in-costume.short: Students in cat ears and curled horns in the courtyard. Seeing them, Selena buys a horned headband.
students-in-costume.summary: Students who wear costume pieces around the Academy: a girl in cat ears, a boy on the steps in curled horns. Seeing them, Selena buys a dark headband shaped like a horned crest. Behind it she lets her own two horns grow through her hair, which she has kept drawn in since she was small.

technicians.line: Lab technicians, on Oro and in Terrinia.
technicians.short: Technicians on Oro who talk two doors from Angela. They say she must be kept hidden.
technicians.summary: Two separate groups of lab workers. On Oro, technicians near the Laboratory talk two doors away from Angela, and she hears every word: keep her hidden, or there would be a backlash, and the will of the planet might not like her getting in the way. In Terrinia, two technicians in the monitor room clear the screen when Chang'e tells them to, so the record of the landing can run.
rows: The Laboratory on Oro; the monitor room in Terrinia

trainers.line: The trainers who drill Angela on Oro's Training Field.
trainers.short: Trainers in the Training Field's gallery on Oro. They order Angela to strike.
trainers.summary: The trainers who watch Oro's androids from the gallery of the Training Field. They order "Android Angela. Strike," and she only raises her shield. They think whatever will not strike can be taught by being hit harder, so they raise the droid's setting. Angela never tells them she does not want to fight.

two-students-in-dark-cloaks.line: Two fallen Selrick students in dark cloaks.
two-students-in-dark-cloaks.short: Two girls in dark cloaks, fallen in the street, with androids standing over them.
two-students-in-dark-cloaks.summary: Two Selrick students, girls in dark cloaks, who fall in the street during the attack on Terrinia. One is on her knees and one cannot rise, with androids standing over them. Ruby cuts the androids down in one swing and tells them to go, and they run. Selrick's record of the landing later shows the androids closing on them.

wounded.line: Hurt soldiers sheltering at the top of the bay road cut.
wounded.short: Wounded soldiers sheltering under Angela's shield at the top of the bay road cut.
wounded.summary: The hurt soldiers at the top of the bay road cut. They shelter under Angela's pink shield until it goes out over them, and they look up. Afterward they lie along the house fronts below the shelters, and the street is full of them when Ruby's old rage rises. At the end, Angela's shield opens over them again.

tutors.short: The Academy's teachers. When the siren sounds, every one is called through the gate portal.
tutors.summary: The teachers of Selrick Academy. When the siren sounds for the attack on the Northeastern sector, every tutor is called through the academy gate portal to fight.

wall-guns.line: The big guns on Terrinia's city wall.
wall-guns.short: The big guns on the city wall. Vexana's father keeps them working. A bent bracket makes one miss.
wall-guns.summary: The big guns on Terrinia's city wall. Vexana's father kept them working, and taught her that a bent bracket under a sight makes a gun miss. On the night of the attack they all fired at once, and the one her father worked went quiet and stayed quiet. Years later, the wall guns of the west ward ask leave to fire on a woman on a platform, and Lesley tells them to hold.

a-19.line: A young galaxy, home of Dawnbreak.
a-19.short: A young galaxy. Dawnbreak lies in A-19.
a-19.summary: A young galaxy. On the map inside Ruby's father's black glass desk, Dawnbreak is labeled as lying in A-19. The map has no scale.

a-20.short: The label beside Oro on the desk map: ORO, A-20.
a-20.summary: The galaxy of planet Oro, far from Dawnbreak's A-19. On the map inside Ruby's father's black glass desk, Oro's light is labeled ORO, A-20. The map has no scale.

changes-classroom.short: Chang'e's classroom, with a screen the width of one wall and a tall stool beside it.
changes-classroom.summary: A classroom at Selrick Academy where Chang'e teaches. It has a screen the width of one wall and a tall stool beside it. There she tells the class about the Will of the Planet and the Control Core, and the light of the screen reaches the back row, where Guinevere and Vexana sit.

guineveres-bedroom.line: Guinevere's bedroom at the House on the hill.
guineveres-bedroom.short: Guinevere's bedroom in the House. At bedtime Hester stands in its open door.
guineveres-bedroom.summary: Guinevere's bedroom in the House on the hill. At bedtime Hester stands in its open door. From the night Hester tells her the story of her mother, Guinevere sleeps with the door open.

karinas-roof.line: The flat roof of Karina's building, with its water tank.
karinas-roof.short: The flat roof of Karina's building, with a water tank. In storms the rain there is loud enough to hide anything.
karinas-roof.summary: The flat roof of Karina's building, with a water tank on it. In storms Selena climbs up, where the rain is loud enough to hide anything, and tests the purple, letting it up her arms and calling it back. On the night the base fell, she watched from there, her hands closed on the rail of the tank.

lesleys-family-kitchen.line: The kitchen of Lesley's childhood home.
lesleys-family-kitchen.short: The kitchen of Lesley's home, where her family of four eats at one table. The biggest piece goes to whoever had the worst day.
lesleys-family-kitchen.summary: The kitchen of the house where Lesley grew up. The four of them eat at one table there, and the biggest piece goes to whoever had the worst day, as her mother decides. Her mother laughs from its door and keeps one birthday candle stub in its drawer, to light on whatever there is.

selenas-school.line: The school Selena went to as a child.
selenas-school.short: Selena's school as a child. In storms the children crawl under the tables, and Selena stands at the window.
selenas-school.summary: The school Selena went to as a child, in the years after the storm. A boy skins his knee on its steps. When a storm comes over it, the children crawl under the tables, and Selena stands at the window, where each crack of thunder makes her bones go calm.

academy-front-steps.line: The stone steps at the front of Selrick Academy.
academy-front-steps.short: The Academy's front steps. Fanny sits there alone at night on the cold stone.
academy-front-steps.summary: The stone steps that lead into Selrick Academy. Fanny sits alone on them one night, the stone cold under her, thinking over the line she gave Layla.

academy-hill.line: The Academy's hill, running down to the water.
academy-hill.short: The hill the Academy stands on. The Storm Citadel's black cloud spreads over it.
academy-hill.summary: The hill the Academy stands on, running down to the water. In the attack the Storm Citadel's black cloud spreads over it, and the ship comes down until it fills the sky from the hill to the water. Then the edge of its field rolls down the hill toward the water.
rows: Under Selrick Academy, down to the bay

academy-lawn.line: The Academy lawn under a yellowing tree.
academy-lawn.short: The Academy lawn. A tree going yellow shades it, and past the shade it lies bright under a blue sky.
academy-lawn.summary: A lawn on the grounds of Selrick Academy. A tree going yellow shades part of it, and past the shade the grass lies bright under a blue sky. Guinevere and Vexana sit there with her drones asleep in the grass, until the lunch bell rings across it.

academy-roofs.line: The Academy roofs, used for jump training.
academy-roofs.short: The Academy roofs, where jump training happens. Layla leaps one gap for 10 POINTS.
academy-roofs.summary: The roofs of Selrick Academy, where jump training takes place. Layla runs and leaps one gap and scores 10 POINTS. Then Fanny swings past on her cables, over that gap and the next, to a roof two floors higher.

arcade.line: A shopping arcade in the city.
arcade.short: An arcade of shops in the city, where Guinevere takes Vexana shopping.
arcade.summary: An arcade of shops in Terrinia. Guinevere takes Vexana shopping there, and Vexana stops in its first doorway. It has a counter of hair things, where Guinevere finds the star clip, and in its middle a fabric stall sells felt in squares of every color.

armory.line: The armory of Lesley's Shield station.
armory.short: The station's armory. Lesley hides under its floorboards so the convoy leaves without her.
armory.summary: The armory of the far Shield station where Lesley grows up. She hides flat under its floorboards so the convoy leaves without her, and the sergeant finds her there. The station keeps its count of dead Enders in chalk strokes on its door, and a long row of them is hers.

bakers.line: The baker's shop on Lesley's childhood street.
bakers.short: The baker's on Lesley's street. Crossing to it, her little brother squeezed her hand when a cart came too fast.
bakers.summary: A baker's shop on the street where Lesley grew up. Once, crossing to it, a cart came down the hill too fast, and her little brother's hand went inside hers and squeezed. "You're squashing," said Lesley.

bases-outer-fence.line: The wire fence around the research base.
bases-outer-fence.short: The research base's outer fence. A blonde girl comes most evenings to watch the base's machines through its wire.
bases-outer-fence.summary: The wire outer fence around Terrinia's research base. A blonde girl, older than Chang'e, comes most evenings to watch the base's machines through its wire. Chang'e waves at her. The girl does not wave back.
